notes.text: The heading abbreviates the title. The stored William Davidson Edition of Berakhot 63a explicitly has Rav Ami bar Mattenah reporting Shmuel, supporting Rav for this occurrence and the direction of reporting. The prior Rabbi title remains superseded; Shmuel receives no added title.
